Prove your worth by beating various bosses.

==Quest information==


===Objectives===
*Prove your worth to Sif. Bring down [[Whiteout]] in [[Jaga Moraine]].
*Test your mettle. Defeat [[Avarr the Fallen]] in Jaga Moraine
*Cement your legacy. Beat the [[Fragment of Antiquities]] in the [[Sepulchre of Dragrimmar]].
*See Sif Shadowhunter for your Reward

===Reward===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Norn reputation point]]s
* 1,000 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
* [[Whiteout]] is on a circular cliff towards the north of [[Jaga Moraine]]. As you approach, a massive [[ice boulder]] rolls down the path. It kills anyone in its way, but there is room to step aside if you act quickly. Note that you do not get a [[death penalty]] from the ice boulder.
* [[Avarr the Fallen]] is on the north-west corner of [[Jaga Moraine]].
* [[Fragment of Antiquities]] is in the very North-West corner of the first level in the map [[Sepulchre of Dragrimmar]]. The [[Sepulchre of Dragrimmar]] is in north-west corner of [[Drakkar Lake]], not far from [[Shrine of the Wolf Spirit]]. In order to be able to reach the Fragment of Antiquities, you need to get the quest [[The Anvil of Dragrimmar]] from [[Outrunner Remlok]] just outside the entrance to the dungeon, or you won't be able to get past the first room. Do NOT mistake Fragment of Antiquities for Remnant of Antiquities (who is the dungeon's boss). They have similar names, but killing the Remnant will not count towards this quest.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Sif Shadowhunter
:''"I see you're back for more. <Character name>. Don't get cocky. Just because you've vanquished some weaklings doesn't mean you're respected. '''Prove your worth''' to me and conquer the same creatures I have. Then maybe you'll earn a reputation… even a song."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Anything you can do I can do better.
| decline = I hate show tunes.
| ask = '''Decimate''' these '''foes''' and prove your might. Go!
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Sif Shadowhunter
:''"Perhaps I misjudged you, human. Despite the odds, you've prevailed. But there is one more thing you must do. Seek me when you are ready to take the final step. I can hear your tune already…."''

==Notes==
* You can save time by combining this quest with [[A Hunter's Pride]], [[Krak's Cavalry]], and [[Prenuptial Disagreement]].

{{bug|Defeating [[Remnant of Antiquities]] may, but does not always, count as defeating [[Fragment of Antiquities]].}}

==Trivia==
*This is likely a reference to the song [[W:Anything You Can Do (song)|Anything You Can Do]] from [[W:Annie Get Your Gun (musical)|Annie Get Your Gun]].
